questions.q: To whom does the elder write this letter?
What does the elder say about the man who loves to be first in the assembly?
options: He refuses to receive the brothers
He takes money from the Gentiles
He writes false letters to the churches
He denies that Jesus came in the flesh

questions.q: Who does the elder say has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself?
I have no greater joy than this: to hear about ____.
I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as ____.
He who does good is of God. He who does evil ____.
The elder says he hopes to see his friend soon and speak face to face.
The elder says the brothers who went out for the sake of the Name accepted support from the Gentiles.
Who loves to be first among them and doesn't accept what the elder says?
Why ought we to receive such traveling brothers, according to the elder?
options: That we may be fellow workers for the truth
That we may gain a reward
That the Gentiles may see our love

questions.q: Before whom did the brothers testify about Gaius's love?
Beloved, you do ____ in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
You will do well to send them forward on their journey ____.
questions.answer: in a way worthy of God

questions.q: The elder rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about Gaius's truth.
